_comment: tools/release/push_repo.tscn: `message` is the commit message (it falls back to a release-tidy message if blank), `check_tag` is a release tag it checks is still live after pushing ("" skips the check).
message:
Day/night cycle, encounters and the weird stuff (D-100..D-110)

Open-world zombie types, safe courses, Act 1 finale and Act 2 chapter 1, the
Suit watcher, 25 random encounters with 20 NPCs and 19 dialogue trees, 18
authored world oddities, 15 collectibles with a bunker display rack, 10 rare
secret events, 12 side quests, an F6 encounter debug panel, and a 48-minute
day/night cycle with doubled night spawns and sleeping in the bunker bunks.
